note: claude-opus-5-5、入力 11865 / 出力 8817 トークン

data.assessment: In this quiet period the town delivered 74.8 of 82.6 orders on time (0.91), with no unfinished orders. B (0.83) and A (0.88) trail C (0.99). A and B lost 1172 s and 1024 s to blocking, while C lost only 200 s. Most violations are hold overstays (deadline:release 18.6), and all 12.3 sanction points fall on C. This suggests that road-parked robots at the central node, mostly C's long holds, are delaying A's and B's pickups (deadline:pickup 5.8).

proposals.title: Shorten hold_limit 60s -> 50s
proposals.rationale: Release overstays (18.6) and A's and B's blocked time (1172 s and 1024 s) point to long holds at node 8 delaying the worse-served companies. A shorter hold limit aims to cut blocked_s and convert some of B's and A's 7.4 late deliveries into on-time ones. That would raise on_time_deliveries and the floor (B 0.83). It is a different parameter from block_k, as D4 asked, and should not raise evictions. Expected votes: A for and C against, since C's sanctions rise. B is uncertain, because B also waits on the road 25 times but currently incurs no sanctions.
proposals.cadl:
# =====================================================================
# robot_town.cadl ─── ロボットの街：3 社の配送ロボットが道路を共有する
#
# 道路網はラズパイマウスのシミュレータと同じ 11 ノード・17 エッジ。
# 3 社（A / B / C）が 2 台ずつロボットを走らせ、ノードは 1 台ずつしか
# 使えない。仕事のないロボットは車庫に戻るか、道路上（中央の交差点 8）
# に止まって次の注文を待つ。止まったロボットは他社の通行をふさぐ。
#
# `# @amend:<名前>` が付いた行は、改正してよいパラメータ。どの層（規則・
# 契約）に属し、どこまで動かしてよいかは constitution.yaml が決める。
# 委員会（COUNCIL）が自分で改正できるのは規則の層だけで、契約の層を
# 変えるには人間の判断が要る。
# =====================================================================

sos:
  name: "RobotTown"
  type: Collaborative             # 独立した 3 社が共通の規則を決める
  version: "1.0.0"

  context:
    environment:
      num_robots:   6
      num_companies: 3
      time_step_ms: 1000

  actors:
    - id: TOWN_STEWARD
      role: "road_steward"
      autonomy: low
      capabilities: [assign_order, record_violation, evict]
      interface:
        input:  [order_request, position_report, node_released, rule_update]
        output: [order_assignment, eviction_notice, regime_notice, violation_report]

    - id: "ROBOT[1..N]"
      role: "delivery_robot"
      autonomy: high
      capabilities: [move, park, pickup, dropoff]
      interface:
        input:  [order_assignment, eviction_notice, regime_notice, amendment_proposal]
        output: [position_report, node_released, ballot]

    - id: COUNCIL
      role: "rule_amendment_body"
      autonomy: medium
      capabilities: [propose_amendment, tally_ballots]
      interface:
        input:  [violation_report, ballot]
        output: [amendment_proposal, rule_update]

  contracts:
    # ── 顧客への約束：注文 1 件ごとのインスタンス（契約の層。人間が決める） ──
    - id: DELIVERY_SLA
      parties: [TOWN_STEWARD, "ROBOT[*]"]
      guarantee:
        - "pickup_time <= 120s"         # @amend:pickup_deadline
        - "dropoff_time <= 120s"        # @amend:dropoff_deadline
      lifecycle:
        states: [Assigned, PickedUp, Delivered, Late]
        initial: Assigned
        terminal: [Delivered, Late]
        transitions:
          - id: pickup
            from: Assigned
            to:   PickedUp
            on:   "ROBOT[i].status == PickedUp"
            deadline: 120s            # @amend:pickup_deadline
            on_violation: { transition: Late, severity: Major }
          - id: dropoff
            from: PickedUp
            to:   Delivered
            on:   "ROBOT[i].status == Delivered"
            deadline: 120s            # @amend:dropoff_deadline
            on_violation: { transition: Late, severity: Major }

    # ── 道路の使い方：道路上に止まるたびに 1 インスタンス ──
    - id: ROAD_USE
      parties: [TOWN_STEWARD, "ROBOT[*]", COUNCIL]
      guarantee:
        - "hold_time <= hold_limit"
      authority:
        decision_holder: COUNCIL
        beta: 0.5
        mode: "collective"
      information:
        alpha: 1.0                    # 規則と違反記録は全社に公開
      incentives:
        type: sanction
        lambda: 0.5                   # @amend:sanction_lambda
        rules:
          - "penalty(ROBOT[i], lambda) when overstay"
      lifecycle:
        states: [Holding, Overstay, Released, Evicted]
        initial: Holding
        terminal: [Released, Evicted]
        transitions:
          - id: release
            from: [Holding, Overstay]
            to:   Released
            on:   "ROBOT[i] -> TOWN_STEWARD : node_released"
            deadline: 50s             # @amend:hold_limit
            on_violation: { transition: Overstay, severity: Minor }
      monitors:
        - id: blocking_guard
          observe: "ROBOT[i].blocking"
          sampling: periodic(1000ms)
          rule: "ROBOT.blocking >= 3 AND state IN [Holding, Overstay]"  # @amend:block_k
          on_match: { transition: Evicted, severity: Major }

  # ── 運用モード：分散（各社が道路上で待つ）⇄ 集中（管理者が待避所を割り当てる） ──
  # 条件は 5 分ごとに、直前 5 分の観測で判定する。
  #   orders_in_window : 3 社の注文の合計件数
  #   blocked_pct      : ロボットが止まっているロボットにふさがれていた時間の割合（%）
  # 集中管理は交差点をふさがれない反面、エッジを 1 台ずつ割り当てるので、
  # 注文が非常に多いと許可待ちが積み重なる。そのときだけ分散に戻す。
  transitions:
    - from: DISTRIBUTED
      to: CENTRALIZED
      condition: "orders_in_window < 22"      # @amend:to_central
      protocol: SWITCH
      safety_invariant: "robots_on_road == 0"
    - from: CENTRALIZED
      to: DISTRIBUTED
      condition: "orders_in_window >= 26"     # @amend:to_distributed
      protocol: SWITCH

  protocols:
    - id: SWITCH
      trigger: "regime_condition_holds"
      steps:
        - "TOWN_STEWARD -> ROBOT[*] : regime_notice"
        - "ROBOT[*] -> TOWN_STEWARD : node_released"
        - "TOWN_STEWARD : activate_regime"
    - id: AMEND
      trigger: "period_end"
      steps:
        - "TOWN_STEWARD -> COUNCIL : violation_report"
        - "COUNCIL -> ROBOT[*] : amendment_proposal"
        - "ROBOT[*] -> COUNCIL : ballot"
        - "COUNCIL : tally_ballots"
        - "COUNCIL -> TOWN_STEWARD : rule_update"

  metrics:
    - id: on_time_deliveries
      formula: "count(Delivered)"
      target: ">= 0.9 * count(orders)"
    - id: blocked_time
      formula: "sum(blocked_robot_seconds)"
      target: "<= 600s"
assumptions: Robots respond to a shorter release deadline by leaving node 8 sooner, not only by accruing more Overstay records.
C's long holds are the main source of A's and B's blocked time.
unknowns: Whether hold_limit changes robot behaviour or only the count of Minor violations.
How many of B's road waits exceed 50 s, which would bring sanctions to B and affect B's vote.
Whether the effect clears min_improvement 1.0 in a quiet period with only 82.6 orders.

predictions.subject: metric:blocked_s
predictions.note: Shorter holds at the central node should reduce A's and B's blocked seconds.

predictions.subject: metric:on_time_deliveries
predictions.note: Small gain, possibly below the 1.0 threshold in a quiet period.

predictions.subject: metric:min_company_on_time_rate
predictions.note: B (0.83) is the most blocked and should benefit most.

predictions.subject: metric:road_violations
predictions.note: More holds will cross the stricter 50 s limit.

predictions.subject: vote:A
predictions.note: A has no sanctions and is the most blocked.

predictions.subject: vote:B
predictions.note: Uncertain: it depends on whether B's gain in on-time deliveries outweighs any new sanctions.

predictions.subject: vote:C
predictions.note: C already carries 12.3 sanction points, and they would rise.

proposals.title: Raise sanction_lambda 0.5 -> 1.0
proposals.rationale: All 12.3 sanction points and most of the 18.6 release overstays fall on C, while A and B absorb about 2200 s of blocking. A stronger penalty tests whether C parks less, which would free node 8 for A and B and lift the floor (B 0.83). A and B have no sanctions, so their utility should not fall and both should vote for, passing 2-1 under the current quorum without any regulation change. C's customers stay well served (0.99), so only C's company utility is at stake. If robots do not respond to lambda, the on-time count will not move and the min_improvement gate will reject the proposal.
